title: The Missing Briefcase
scene: At 4:35 PM, a briefcase vanished from the station bench. Platform three closed during a signal fault from 4:20 to 4:50.

suspects.name: Quinn Sato
suspects.testimony: I was on platform two at 4:35, waiting for my train.
suspects.alibiProof: The platform two camera shows Quinn at 4:31 and 4:39.

suspects.name: Rosa Vale
suspects.testimony: I was carrying luggage on platform three at 4:35.
suspects.contradiction: Platform three was closed by the signal fault, and the case tag was in Rosa's pocket.

suspects.name: Sam Ash
suspects.testimony: I was at the ticket window at 4:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The window camera shows Sam at 4:33 and 4:41.

suspects.name: Tito Reed
suspects.testimony: I was outside on the forecourt at 4:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The forecourt camera shows Tito's cab at 4:32 and 4:44.
